name: Elizabeth (Eliza) Hamilton
notable_stories: Migrated to Ohio following the death of Jose Pierre, providing the link for the missing Ohio branch of the family
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Birth changed from "abt 1791" to "abt 1785". The 1820 and 1830 censuses place her birth between 1780 and 1790 (Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012). Decision by Brendan Adams.
Per Dale Morrow's Hamilton research, several of her siblings moved to Darke County, Ohio in the very early 1800s. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7356]
The 1850 census shows her living with the Gills, alongside a Sam'l Peer [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8691]
Had at least one daughter and one son [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 9674]
Received 25 1/2 acres in the distribution of her father's estate [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 9224]
